calibration_required_before_local_decisi: dated disruption and recovery logs by metro, bus, bicycle, curb and external gateway
15-minute mode, station, stop, curb and accessible-route counts
announcement lead time, alternate-mode acceptance and denied-boarding observations
grouped recovery time and accessible-route verification records
enterprise and resident satisfaction/intercept evidence without continuous personal traces
named maintenance owner, service window and public-route restoration receipt
interpretation: This staged screen makes early warning, bounded mode shift, human takeover and asset recovery visible in one aggregate ledger. It is not a timetable, incident forecast, resident satisfaction survey, local resilience claim or permission to operate an air service. Replace every declared input with dated local evidence before decisions.
